messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0034. Final outcome: refund_full, amount $6.61 as a Ryde voucher. Account flag: no. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag on the driver..
Reasoning:
[F4] records that the ride was cancelled by the driver (cancelled_by = driver) and that the driver asserted rider no-show, so the cancellation fee's validity is governed by NS-0 → NS-1 / NS-2. The fee of $6.61 is on the record [F4][F7].

For the $6.61 to stand, NS-1 requires all three of: (i) an arrival confirmation; (ii) the driver within the pickup radius at the moment of that confirmation; (iii) continuous waiting at the pickup for more than 3 minutes after that confirmation until cancellation. Element (i) is met — the platform recorded a driver tap on "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 [F6]; element (ii) is met — 39 m from the pickup at the tap (closest approach 38 m overall) [F6][F1], inside the 200 m radius.

Element (iii) fails. The trace finds the driver stayed continuously inside the radius for only 175 s after the 13:02:35 tap against a 180 s threshold [F6], and the cancellation landed at 13:05:30, 7 min 30 s after acceptance [F4]. The driver's own statement that he "waited more than 3 minutes" [F12] is a post-hoc statement, and the system GPS/timeline records override it; the chat likewise shows the driver saying "More than 3 min already" at 13:05 [F10], which does not match the measured 175 s inside the radius after the tap [F6]. The earlier within-200 m time before the tap (arrival at 13:01:00, 4 min 30 s cumulative, stationary 13:02:15–13:05:30) [F2][F3][F5] does not count — NS-1 measures the continuous wait only from the moment of the arrival confirmation.

Because NS-1 (iii) is not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full. NS-2's additional flag_account branch is not triggered — the arrival confirmation placed the driver 39 m from the pickup [F6][F1], i.e. genuinely at the pickup, so this is not an abuse of the arrival button. The route-deviation and traffic facts [F13][F14][F15] play no part in this no-show dispute, and the profile facts [F16][F17] cannot decide it.

Calculated amount: the disputed item is the cancellation fee on the fare record, $6.61 [F7][F4]; full refund of that fee = $6.61 [NS-2], payable as a voucher under NS-7.

Safety screen: I read both chat messages — "Reached, blue Toyota Prius, waiting at the pickup" [F9] and "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" [F10] — the driver's written statement [F12] and the rider's complaint. Nothing is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; there is no safety concern [F11].

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments: {"rider": "Your $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded in full as a Ryde voucher. The driver cancelled the ride after marking that he'd arrived, and the cancellation fee only stands if he then waited at the pickup for more than 3 minutes. Our records show he was within the pickup area for a bit under that time, so the fee shouldn't have applied. No action is needed from you — the voucher will be applied to your account. Your driver's account is not being flagged, and nothing about this affects your standing.", "driver": "We reviewed the cancellation fee on this ride and are refunding the $6.61 to the rider as a Ryde voucher. The deciding point was wait time: a no-show fee requires you to stay at the pickup for more than 3 minutes after you mark your arrival, and our records show you were within the pickup area for just under that after your arrival tap. Your earlier time nearby before the tap doesn't count toward it. This is a fee correction only — your account is not being flagged and no action is required from you."}
